english.sodium.options.view_distance.tooltip: The render distance controls how far away terrain will be rendered. Shorter distances mean that less terrain will be rendered, improving frame rates.
english.sodium.options.simulation_distance.toolt: The simulation distance controls how far away terrain and entities will be loaded and ticked. Shorter distances can reduce the internal server's load and may improve frame rates.
english.sodium.options.brightness.tooltip: Controls the minimum brightness in the world. When increased, darker areas of the world will appear brighter. This does not affect the brightness of already well-lit areas.
english.sodium.options.gui_scale.tooltip: Sets the maximum scale factor to be used for the user interface. If "auto" is used, then the largest scale factor will always be used.
english.sodium.options.fullscreen.tooltip: If enabled, the game will display in full-screen (if supported).
english.sodium.options.fullscreen_resolution.too:
The monitor resolution and refresh rate to be used when in fullscreen mode. Changing this option may interfere with other applications and cause a delay when switching between applications.

This is only supported on the Windows or macOS operating systems.
english.sodium.options.v_sync.tooltip: If enabled, the game's frame rate will be synchronized to the monitor's refresh rate, making for a generally smoother experience at the expense of overall input latency. This setting might reduce performance if your system is too slow.
english.sodium.options.fps_limit.tooltip: Limits the maximum number of frames per second. This can help reduce battery usage and system load when multi-tasking. If VSync is enabled, this option will be ignored unless it is lower than your display's refresh rate.
english.sodium.options.view_bobbing.tooltip: If enabled, the player's view will sway and bob when moving around. Players who experience motion sickness while playing may benefit from disabling this.
english.sodium.options.attack_indicator.tooltip: Controls where the Attack Indicator is displayed on screen.
english.sodium.options.autosave_indicator.toolti: If enabled, an indicator will be shown when the game is saving the world to disk.
english.sodium.options.graphics_quality.tooltip: The default graphics quality controls some legacy options and is necessary for mod compatibility. If the options below are left to "Default", they will use this setting.
english.sodium.options.clouds_quality.tooltip: The quality level used for rendering clouds in the sky. Even though the options are labeled "Fast" and "Fancy", the effect on performance is negligible.
english.sodium.options.weather_quality.tooltip: Controls the distance that weather effects, such as rain and snow, will be rendered.
english.sodium.options.leaves_quality.name: Leaves
english.sodium.options.leaves_quality.tooltip: Controls whether leaves will be rendered as transparent (fancy) or opaque (fast).
english.sodium.options.particle_quality.tooltip: Controls the maximum number of particles which can be present on screen at any one time.
english.sodium.options.smooth_lighting.tooltip: Enables the smooth lighting and shading of blocks in the world. This can very slightly increase the amount of time it takes to load or update a chunk, but it doesn't affect frame rates.
english.sodium.options.biome_blend.tooltip: The area (in blocks) where biome colors are smoothly blended across. Default is 5x5. Higher values will greatly increase the amount of time it takes to load or update chunks, for diminishing improvements in quality.
english.sodium.options.entity_distance.tooltip: The render distance multiplier used by entity rendering. Smaller values decrease, and larger values increase, the maximum distance at which entities will be rendered.
english.sodium.options.entity_shadows.tooltip: If enabled, basic shadows will be rendered beneath mobs and other entities.
english.sodium.options.vignette.name: Vignette
english.sodium.options.vignette.tooltip: If enabled, a vignette effect will be applied when the player is in darker areas, which makes the overall image darker and more dramatic.
english.sodium.options.mipmap_levels.tooltip: Controls the number of mipmaps which will be used for block model textures. Higher values provide better rendering of blocks in the distance, but could adversely affect performance with resource packs that use many animated textures.
english.sodium.options.use_block_face_culling.to: If enabled, only the faces of blocks which are facing the camera will be submitted for rendering. This can eliminate a large number of block faces very early in the rendering process, which greatly improves rendering performance. Some resource packs may have issues with this option, so try disabling it if you're seeing holes in blocks.
english.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.name: Use Fog Occlusion
english.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.tooltip: If enabled, chunks which are determined to be fully hidden by fog effects will not be rendered, helping to improve performance. The improvement can be more dramatic when fog effects are heavier (such as while underwater), but it may cause undesirable visual artifacts between the sky and fog in some scenarios.
english.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.name: Use Entity Culling
english.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.toolti: If enabled, entities which are within the camera viewport, but not inside of a visible chunk, will be skipped during rendering. This optimization uses the visibility data which already exists for chunk rendering and does not add overhead.
english.sodium.options.animate_only_visible_text: If enabled, only the animated textures which are determined to be visible in the current image will be updated. This can provide a significant performance improvement on some hardware, especially with heavier resource packs. If you experience issues with some textures not being animated, try disabling this option.
english.sodium.options.cpu_render_ahead_limit.to: For debugging only. Specifies the maximum number of frames which can be in-flight to the GPU. Changing this value is not recommended, as very low or high values may create frame rate instability.
english.sodium.options.use_persistent_mapping.to:
For debugging only. If enabled, persistent memory mappings will be used for the staging buffer so that unnecessary memory copies can be avoided. Disabling this can be useful for narrowing down the cause of graphical corruption.

Requires OpenGL 4.4 or ARB_buffer_storage.
english.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.name: Chunk Update Threads
english.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.tool: Specifies the number of threads to use for chunk building and sorting. Using more threads can speed up chunk loading and update speed, but may negatively impact frame times. The default value is usually good enough for all situations.
english.sodium.options.defer_chunk_updates.name: Chunk Updates
english.sodium.options.defer_chunk_updates.toolt: If set to "Deferred", rendering will never wait for nearby chunk updates to finish, even if they are important. This can greatly improve frame rates in some scenarios, but it may create significant visual lag where blocks take a while to appear or disappear. "Immediate" eliminates visual lag by blocking the frame until chunk updates are complete while "Soon" allows at most one frame of visual lag.
english.sodium.options.quad_splitting.name: Block Transparency Limits
english.sodium.options.quad_splitting.tooltip: Determines what approach is used to make translucent blocks (not entities or items) look correct even when they intersect or have unusual shapes, such as waterlogged stained glass panes. "Basic" disables this feature and such blocks may render incorrectly. "Safe" limits the amount of newly generated geometry to prevent instability in extreme cases, while "Unlimited" imposes no limit.
english.sodium.options.closest_point_entity_sort: Controls how the translucent geometry of entities is sorted. "Enhanced" sorts by the closest point to the camera, which improves rendering accuracy for translucent quads with different sizes, at a small CPU cost. "Default" uses the standard sorting.
english.sodium.options.use_no_error_context.name: Use No Error Context
english.sodium.options.use_no_error_context.tool: When enabled, the OpenGL context will be created with error checking disabled. This slightly improves rendering performance, but it can make debugging sudden unexplained crashes much harder.
english.sodium.console.game_restart: The game must be restarted to apply one or more video settings!
english.sodium.console.broken_nvidia_driver:
Your NVIDIA graphics drivers are out of date!
  * This will cause severe performance issues and crashes when Sodium is installed.
  * Please update your graphics drivers to the latest version (version 536.23 or newer.)
english.sodium.console.core_shaders_error: The following resource packs are incompatible with Sodium:
english.sodium.console.core_shaders_warn: The following resource packs may be incompatible with Sodium:
english.sodium.console.core_shaders_info: Check the game log for detailed information.
english.sodium.console.config_not_loaded: The configuration file for Sodium has been corrupted, or is currently unreadable. Some options have been temporarily reset to their defaults. Please open the Video Settings screen to resolve this problem.
english.sodium.console.corrupt_config.console.co: The config file has been reset to known-good defaults.
english.sodium.console.corrupt_config.console.ti: Sodium failed to load the configuration file
english.sodium.console.corrupt_config.message.ti: Could not load the configuration file
english.sodium.console.corrupt_config.message.bo:
A problem occurred while trying to load the configuration file. This
can happen when the file has been corrupted on disk, or when trying
to manually edit the file by hand.

If you continue, the configuration file will be reset back to known-good
defaults, and you will lose any changes that have since been made to your
Video Settings.

More information about the error can be found in the log file.

added.sodium.options.view_distance.tooltip: 控制地形的渲染范围。缩短距离会减少渲染的地形，提高帧率。
added.sodium.options.simulation_distance.toolt: 控制地形和实体的加载与运算范围。缩短距离可减轻内部服务器负担，并可能提高帧率。
added.sodium.options.brightness.tooltip: 控制世界的最低亮度。提高此值会使暗处更亮，但不影响已经明亮的区域。
added.sodium.options.gui_scale.tooltip: 设置界面的最大缩放倍率。选择“自动”时，始终使用可用的最大倍率。
added.sodium.options.fullscreen.tooltip: 启用后，游戏以全屏模式显示（需要系统支持）。
added.sodium.options.fullscreen_resolution.too:
设置全屏模式下的显示器分辨率与刷新率。修改可能影响其他应用，并使切换应用时出现延迟。

仅支持 Windows 和 macOS。
added.sodium.options.v_sync.tooltip: 将游戏帧率与显示器刷新率同步，使画面更平滑，但会增加输入延迟。性能较低的系统可能因此降低帧率。
added.sodium.options.fps_limit.tooltip: 限制每秒最大帧数，有助于在多任务运行时降低耗电和系统负担。启用垂直同步后，仅低于显示器刷新率的限制会生效。
added.sodium.options.view_bobbing.tooltip: 启用后，移动时视角会摇晃。容易产生晕动不适的玩家可以关闭此项。
added.sodium.options.attack_indicator.tooltip: 设置攻击指示器在屏幕上的显示位置。
added.sodium.options.autosave_indicator.toolti: 启用后，游戏将世界保存到磁盘时会显示提示。
added.sodium.options.graphics_quality.tooltip: 默认画质控制部分传统选项，也是模组兼容所需的设置。下方设为“默认”的选项会采用此项的设置。
added.sodium.options.clouds_quality.tooltip: 设置天空中云的渲染质量。“快速”和“高品质”对性能的影响很小。
added.sodium.options.weather_quality.tooltip: 控制雨雪等天气效果的渲染距离。
added.sodium.options.leaves_quality.name: 树叶
added.sodium.options.leaves_quality.tooltip: 控制树叶显示为透明（高品质）还是不透明（快速）。
added.sodium.options.particle_quality.tooltip: 控制屏幕上可同时显示的最大粒子数量。
added.sodium.options.smooth_lighting.tooltip: 为世界中的方块启用平滑光照与明暗过渡。可能略微增加区块加载或更新时间，但不影响帧率。
added.sodium.options.biome_blend.tooltip: 设置生物群系颜色平滑混合的范围，单位为方块。默认范围为 5×5；扩大范围会显著增加区块加载和更新时间，画质收益逐渐减小。
added.sodium.options.entity_distance.tooltip: 设置实体渲染距离的倍率。降低或提高此值会相应缩短或扩大实体的最大渲染距离。
added.sodium.options.entity_shadows.tooltip: 启用后，在生物和其他实体下方绘制基础阴影。
added.sodium.options.vignette.name: 暗角
added.sodium.options.vignette.tooltip: 启用后，身处暗处时会显示暗角效果，使整体画面更暗、明暗氛围更强。
added.sodium.options.mipmap_levels.tooltip: 控制方块模型纹理使用的多级渐远纹理层数。较高的值可改善远处方块的显示，但使用大量动画纹理的资源包时可能降低性能。
added.sodium.options.use_block_face_culling.to: 仅提交朝向相机的方块面进行渲染，可在渲染早期排除大量面，明显提高性能。部分资源包可能不兼容；若方块出现缺口，可尝试关闭此项。
added.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.name: 雾遮挡剔除
added.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.tooltip: 跳过完全被雾遮挡的区块以提高性能。水下等浓雾场景的收益可能更大，但某些情况下天空与雾之间可能出现显示异常。
added.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.name: 实体剔除
added.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.toolti: 跳过位于相机视野内、但不在可见区块中的实体。此优化复用区块渲染的可见性数据，不增加额外计算负担。
added.sodium.options.animate_only_visible_text: 仅更新当前画面中可见的纹理动画。在部分硬件上，尤其使用较复杂资源包时，可明显提高性能。若纹理动画异常，可尝试关闭此项。
added.sodium.options.cpu_render_ahead_limit.to: 仅供调试。控制可同时提交给 GPU、尚未完成的最大帧数。不建议修改；过低或过高都可能导致帧率不稳定。
added.sodium.options.use_persistent_mapping.to:
仅供调试。对暂存缓冲区使用持久内存映射，减少不必要的内存复制。关闭可用于排查画面损坏的原因。

需要 OpenGL 4.4 或 ARB_buffer_storage。
added.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.name: 区块更新线程数
added.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.tool: 设置区块构建与排序使用的线程数。更多线程可加快区块加载和更新，但也可能影响帧耗时稳定性。通常默认值已足够。
added.sodium.options.defer_chunk_updates.name: 区块更新
added.sodium.options.defer_chunk_updates.toolt: “延后”不会等待附近区块更新完成，即使更新很重要；可显著提高部分场景的帧率，但方块出现或消失可能明显延迟。“立即”会等待更新完成以消除显示延迟；“尽快”最多允许一帧的显示延迟。
added.sodium.options.quad_splitting.name: 方块透明处理限制
added.sodium.options.quad_splitting.tooltip: 控制相交或形状特殊的半透明方块（例如含水染色玻璃板）的处理方式，不影响实体和物品。“基础”关闭此功能，可能显示错误；“安全”限制新增几何量，避免极端情况导致不稳定；“无限制”不设上限。
added.sodium.options.closest_point_entity_sort: 控制实体半透明几何的排序方式。“增强”按到相机的最近点排序，改善不同大小半透明面的显示准确性，但会少量增加 CPU 开销。“默认”使用标准排序。
added.sodium.options.use_no_error_context.name: 无错误检查上下文
added.sodium.options.use_no_error_context.tool: 创建 OpenGL 上下文时关闭错误检查，可略微提高渲染性能，但会使突发且原因不明的崩溃更难排查。
added.sodium.console.game_restart: 部分视频设置需要重启游戏才能生效！
added.sodium.console.broken_nvidia_driver:
NVIDIA 显卡驱动已过时！
  * 安装 Sodium 后，这可能导致严重的性能问题和崩溃。
  * 请更新显卡驱动至最新版本（536.23 或更新版本）。
added.sodium.console.core_shaders_error: 以下资源包与 Sodium 不兼容：
added.sodium.console.core_shaders_warn: 以下资源包可能与 Sodium 不兼容：
added.sodium.console.core_shaders_info: 详细信息请查看游戏日志。
added.sodium.console.config_not_loaded: Sodium 配置文件已损坏或暂时无法读取。部分选项已临时恢复默认值。请打开视频设置页处理此问题。
added.sodium.console.corrupt_config.console.co: 配置文件已恢复为已知可用的默认值。
added.sodium.console.corrupt_config.console.ti: Sodium 无法加载配置文件
added.sodium.console.corrupt_config.message.bo:
加载配置文件时发生错误。文件在磁盘上损坏，或手动编辑配置文件，都可能导致此问题。

如果继续，配置文件将恢复为已知可用的默认值，你对视频设置的修改将丢失。

详细错误信息请查看日志文件。

english.rso.narration.scrollbar.usage.vertical: Press Up or Down to scroll
english.rso.narration.scrollbar.usage.horizontal: Press Left or Right to scroll
english.rso.options.enabled.name: Enable Reese's Sodium Options
english.rso.options.enabled.tooltip: Replaces Sodium's options screen with Reese's Sodium Options. When disabled, Sodium's default screen is shown instead. Applying this option reopens the screen.
english.rso.options.tab_header_icons.name: Tab Header Icons
english.rso.options.tab_header_icons.tooltip: Controls whether mod icons are shown in tab headers.
english.rso.options.tab_header_version_labels.to: Controls whether mod version labels are shown in tab headers.
english.rso.options.tab_header_collapse_mode.too: Controls how mod tab headers expand and collapse in the sidebar.
english.rso.options.tab_headers.name: Tab Headers
english.rso.options.tab_headers.tooltip: Shows mod tab header rows when Tab Header Collapse Mode is set to All Expanded.
Shows single-page mods as only their tab header instead of also showing a page tab.
english.rso.options.collapsible_groups.name: Collapsible Groups
english.rso.options.collapsible_groups.tooltip: Makes option group headers within a page clickable to collapse or expand the options beneath them.
english.rso.options.tooltip_delay.name: Tooltip Delay
english.rso.options.tooltip_delay.tooltip: Controls how long an option must be hovered before its tooltip is shown.
english.rso.options.tooltip_option_ids.name: Tooltip Option Identifiers
english.rso.options.tooltip_option_ids.tooltip: Shows option identifiers at the top of option tooltips.
english.rso.options.color_themes.name: Color Themes
english.rso.options.color_themes.tooltip: Controls whether tab buttons, option controls, and tooltip borders use each mod's color theme.
english.rso.options.themed_headers_and_labels.to: Applies each mod's color theme to tab headers, mod icons, and option group labels.
english.rso.options.themed_tooltip_borders.name: Themed Tooltip Borders
english.rso.options.themed_tooltip_borders.toolt: Applies each mod's color theme to option tooltip borders.
english.rso.options.reduced_motion.name: Reduced Motion
english.rso.options.reduced_motion.tooltip: Disables animated tab header text scrolling and cursor fading.
english.rso.options.reverse_cycling_controls.too: Allows right-clicking cycling controls to move backward through values.
english.rso.options.shift_scroll_slider_adjustme: Allows scrolling over sliders while holding Shift to adjust their values.
english.rso.options.search_result_limit.name: Search Result Limit
english.rso.options.search_result_limit.tooltip: Controls the maximum number of matching options returned by search.
english.rso.options.hide_non_matching_options.to: Hides options that do not match the active search query.
english.rso.options.hide_non_matching_tabs.name: Hide Non-Matching Tabs
english.rso.options.hide_non_matching_tabs.toolt: Hides tabs that do not contain options matching the active search query.
english.rso.options.disabled_option_visibility.t: Controls whether disabled options stay visible or are hidden from option lists.
english.rso.options.focus_border_mode.name: Focus Border Mode
english.rso.options.focus_border_mode.tooltip: Controls when keyboard focus borders are drawn around focused controls.
english.rso.options.controller_guides.name: Controller Guides
english.rso.options.controller_guides.tooltip: Shows controller button hints in the footer when using a controller.
english.rso.options.reset_button_overlay.name: Reset Button Overlay
english.rso.options.reset_button_overlay.tooltip: Shows the reset-to-default button on options whose current value differs from the default.
english.rso.options.undo_button_overlay.name: Undo Button Overlay
english.rso.options.undo_button_overlay.tooltip: Shows an undo button on changed options to restore their applied value.
english.rso.options.always_show_action_buttons.t: Keeps reset and undo buttons visible when their overlay is enabled, drawing unavailable actions as disabled.
english.rso.options.support_project.name: Support the project via Ko-fi
english.rso.options.support_project.tooltip: Opens FlashyReese's Ko-fi page in your browser.
english.modmenu.descriptionTranslation.reeses-so: Replaces Sodium's Options Screen with intention of improving UX

original.modmenu.summaryTranslation.reeses-sodium: 取代 Sodium 的选项屏幕
original.modmenu.descriptionTranslation.reeses-so: 替换 Sodium 的选项屏幕，旨在改善用户体验。

added.rso.options.enabled.name: 启用 Reese's Sodium Options
added.rso.options.enabled.tooltip: 用 Reese's Sodium Options 替换 Sodium 的设置页。关闭后显示 Sodium 默认设置页。应用此选项会重新打开设置页。
added.rso.options.tab_header_icons.name: 标签页标题图标
added.rso.options.tab_header_icons.tooltip: 在标签页标题中显示模组图标。
added.rso.options.tab_header_version_labels.to: 在标签页标题中显示模组版本号。
added.rso.options.tab_header_collapse_mode.too: 控制侧栏中模组标签页标题的展开与折叠方式。
added.rso.options.tab_headers.name: 标签页标题
added.rso.options.tab_headers.tooltip: 折叠方式设为“全部展开”时，显示模组标签页的标题行。
只有一个设置页的模组仅显示标签页标题，不再另列页面标签。
added.rso.options.collapsible_groups.name: 可折叠分组
added.rso.options.collapsible_groups.tooltip: 允许点击页面内的选项分组标题，折叠或展开其下方的选项。
added.rso.options.tooltip_delay.name: 提示延迟
added.rso.options.tooltip_delay.tooltip: 设置鼠标悬停在选项上多久后显示提示。
added.rso.options.tooltip_option_ids.name: 提示中显示选项标识
added.rso.options.tooltip_option_ids.tooltip: 在选项提示的顶部显示选项标识符。
added.rso.options.color_themes.name: 主题配色
added.rso.options.color_themes.tooltip: 标签页按钮、选项控件和提示边框采用各模组的主题配色。
added.rso.options.themed_headers_and_labels.to: 将各模组的主题配色用于标签页标题、模组图标和选项分组标签。
added.rso.options.themed_tooltip_borders.name: 提示边框主题配色
added.rso.options.themed_tooltip_borders.toolt: 将各模组的主题配色用于选项提示的边框。
added.rso.options.reduced_motion.name: 减少动画
added.rso.options.reduced_motion.tooltip: 关闭标签页标题文字滚动和光标淡出动画。
added.rso.options.reverse_cycling_controls.too: 允许右键点击循环选项控件，切换到上一个值。
added.rso.options.shift_scroll_slider_adjustme: 按住 Shift 时，允许用鼠标滚轮调整指向的滑块。
added.rso.options.search_result_limit.name: 搜索结果上限
added.rso.options.search_result_limit.tooltip: 设置搜索可返回的匹配选项数量上限。
added.rso.options.hide_non_matching_options.to: 隐藏与当前搜索内容不匹配的选项。
added.rso.options.hide_non_matching_tabs.name: 隐藏不匹配的标签页
added.rso.options.hide_non_matching_tabs.toolt: 隐藏没有任何选项匹配当前搜索内容的标签页。
added.rso.options.disabled_option_visibility.t: 控制已禁用的选项在列表中继续显示还是隐藏。
added.rso.options.focus_border_mode.name: 焦点边框显示方式
added.rso.options.focus_border_mode.tooltip: 控制何时为获得焦点的控件绘制键盘焦点边框。
added.rso.options.controller_guides.name: 手柄操作提示
added.rso.options.controller_guides.tooltip: 使用手柄时，在页脚显示手柄按钮提示。
added.rso.options.reset_button_overlay.name: 重置按钮
added.rso.options.reset_button_overlay.tooltip: 当选项当前值与默认值不同时，在选项上显示恢复默认值的按钮。
added.rso.options.undo_button_overlay.name: 撤销按钮
added.rso.options.undo_button_overlay.tooltip: 在已修改的选项上显示撤销按钮，将其恢复到已应用的值。
added.rso.options.always_show_action_buttons.t: 启用重置或撤销按钮后，使其始终可见；不可用的操作显示为禁用状态。
added.rso.options.support_project.name: 通过 Ko-fi 支持项目
added.rso.options.support_project.tooltip: 在浏览器中打开 FlashyReese 的 Ko-fi 页面。

english.sodiumdynamiclights.menu.title: SodiumDynamicLights Settings
english.sodiumdynamiclights.menu.canvas.1: Disabling entities dynamic lighting is recommended with Canvas!
english.sodiumdynamiclights.menu.canvas.2: Dynamic lighting with Canvas is currently performance heavy!
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.creeper_ligh:
Sets the Creeper dynamic lighting mode.
- %s disables Creeper dynamic lighting.
- %s sets a constant luminance.
- %s sets a dynamic luminance.
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.entities: Enables entities dynamic lighting. Note: players are always active.
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.mode.1: Enables dynamic lights. If enabled a player holding a torch will light up the area for example.
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.mode.2: %s and %s will lag a bit behind but minimizes light updates.
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.self_light_s: Enables first-person dynamic lighting. It's recommended to disable this if you're using shaders that has their own dynamic lighting.
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.tnt_lighting:
Sets the TNT dynamic lighting mode.
- %s disables TNT dynamic lighting.
- %s sets a constant luminance.
- %s sets a dynamic luminance.
english.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.water_sensit: Enables the water-sensitive light sources check. This means that some items will not emit light while being submerged in water.
english.sodium.dynamiclights.options.mode.desc: Configures the update rate for dynamic light sources
english.sodium.dynamiclights.options.self.desc: Enables first-person dynamic lighting. It's recommended to disable this if you're using shaders that has their own dynamic lighting.
english.sodium.dynamiclights.options.entities.de: If enabled, entities (such as mobs and dropped items) will have dynamic lighting.
english.sodium.dynamiclights.options.blockentiti: If enabled, block entities will have dynamic lighting.
Enables the water-sensitive light sources check. This means that some items will not emit light while being submerged in water.
english.sodium.dynamiclights.options.tnt.desc: Configures the update rate for TNT lighting.
english.sodium.dynamiclights.options.creeper.des: Configures the update rate for Creeper lighting.

original.sodiumdynamiclights.menu.title: SodiumDynamicLights设置
original.sodiumdynamiclights.menu.canvas.1: 建议在使用Canvas时禁用实体动态光照！
original.sodiumdynamiclights.menu.canvas.2: 目前动态光照与Canvas同时使用会非常地吃性能！
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.block_entiti: 启用方块实体的动态光照。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.creeper_ligh:
设置苦力怕的动态光照模式。
- %s 禁用苦力怕动态光照。
- %s 会设置一个恒定的亮度。
- %s 会设置动态的亮度。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.entities: 启用实体动态光照。注：与玩家的设置相独立。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.mode.1: 启用动态光照。若启用，手持光源的玩家将照亮其附近。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.mode.2: %s 和 %s 会略有延迟，以减少光照更新。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.self_light_s: 启用第一人称动态光照。如果你使用自带动态光照的着色器，建议禁用该功能。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.tnt_lighting:
设置TNT的动态光照模式。
- %s 禁用TNT动态光照。
- %s 会设置一个恒定的亮度。
- %s 会设置动态的亮度。
original.sodiumdynamiclights.tooltip.water_sensit: 启用水敏光源检查。这意味着某些物品被浸没在水中时将不会发光。

added.sodium.dynamiclights.options.mode.desc: 设置动态光源的更新频率。
added.sodium.dynamiclights.options.self.desc: 启用第一人称动态光照。使用自带动态光照的光影包时，建议关闭此项。
added.sodium.dynamiclights.options.entities.de: 为生物、掉落物等实体启用动态光照。
added.sodium.dynamiclights.options.blockentiti: 为方块实体启用动态光照。
检查光源是否受水影响。启用后，部分物品浸入水中时不会发光。
added.sodium.dynamiclights.options.tnt.desc: 设置 TNT 光照的更新频率。
added.sodium.dynamiclights.options.creeper.des: 设置苦力怕光照的更新频率。

english.sodium.extras.options.clouds.height.desc:
Raises cloud height.
Configure the height of the clouds
english.sodium.extras.options.culling.entity.des: If enabled, Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
english.sodium.extras.options.culling.entity.dis: Hides and does not tick entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around modded farms.
Hides and does not tick entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
english.sodium.extras.options.culling.tiles.desc: If enabled, Block Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
english.sodium.extras.options.culling.tile.dista: Hides block entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around lots of modded machines.

Hides block entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves (if you have your machines in caves, for some reason). This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.mode.desc:
Makes the rest of the world more realistically dark. Does not effect daytime or torch light.
Controls how dark is considered true darkness.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.others.de:
If enabled, true darkness will be applied in other dimensions

[WARNING] This option will be removed in a near future in favor of a blacklist
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.overworld: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Overworld.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.noskyligh: If enabled, true darkness will be applied on dimensions without skylight
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.nether.de: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Nether.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.nether.br: Configure fog brightness in the Nether when darkness is enabled.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.end.title: Enable on End
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.end.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the End.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.end.brigh: Configure fog brightness in the End when darkness is enabled.
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.blockligh: If enabled, Disables sky, fog and moon brightness, making blocks as a only source of light
english.sodium.extras.options.darkness.moonphase: If enabled, Darkness will be affected by Moon Phases
Configure brightness on a new moon, or minimal bright level on black moon phase
Configure brightness on a full moon, or maximum bright level on black moon phase
english.sodium.extras.options.displayfps.title: Display FPS
english.sodium.extras.options.displayfps.desc: Displays the current FPS. Advanced mode also displays minimum FPS, as well as 15 second average FPS, useful for judging performance.
english.sodium.extras.options.displayfps.gravity: Corner position of the FPS display
Displays memory usage and GPU usage beside FPS counter
Add a Shadow box onto FPS Display, at the pure style of F3
english.sodium.extras.options.dynlights.tiles.de:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on tile entities (furnaces, modded machines, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not around furnaces
english.sodium.extras.options.dynlights.entities:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on entities (dropped items, mobs, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not holding a torch.
english.sodium.extras.options.dynlights.speed.de:
Controls how often dynamic lights will update.

Lighting recalculation can be expensive, so slower values will give better performance.
english.sodium.extras.options.fadein.title: Chunk Fade In Quality
english.sodium.extras.options.fadein.desc: Controls how fast chunks fade in. No performance hit, Fancy simply takes longer, but looks a bit cooler. Currently not working
english.sodium.extras.options.fastchest.title: Use Fast Chests
english.sodium.extras.options.fastchest.desc:
If enabled, replaces chests model with a static model, like a normal block. Breaks chest animation but goes more faster on chest rooms

Option has no effects with flywheel installed and running batching or instancing backend
english.sodium.extras.options.fastbeds.title: Use Fast Beds
english.sodium.extras.options.fastbeds.desc: If enabled, replaces dynamic bed model with a static model, like a normal block. Increases performance and also let you use custom models with resource packs
english.sodium.extras.options.fog.title: Use Fog
english.sodium.extras.options.fog.desc: If disabled, removed fog effect only in the overworld
english.sodium.extras.options.fontshadow.title: Font Shadows
english.sodium.extras.options.fontshadow.desc:
If disabled, text will stop rendering shadows giving a flat style.
Increases FPS depending of how much text is on the screen, specially with BetterF3 mods
english.sodium.extras.options.jei.title: Hide JEI Until Searching
english.sodium.extras.options.jei.desc: If enabled, JEI item list will be hidden unless you search for something. Press space to search for everything.
english.sodium.extras.options.screen.title: Fullscreen Mode
english.sodium.extras.options.screen.desc:
Windowed - the game will display in a small window.
Borderless - the game will be fullscreened, and locked to your monitor's refresh rate, but allow you to tab out easily.
Fullscreen - the game will display in native fullscreen mode.
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.cinematic.des:
Enable Cinematic Camera while zooming.
If you disable this, you should also try setting `zoomSmoothnessMs` to `0`
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.sensitive.des:
Mouse Sensitivity will not be reduced below this amount while zoomed in.
Set to `1.0` to prevent it from being changed at all (not recommended without `enableCinematicZoom`)
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.speed.title: Zoom Speed
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.speed.desc: Speed for Zoom In/Out key binds & zoom scrolling (if enabled).
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.scrolling.des:
Allows you to zoom in and out by scrolling up and down on your mouse while zoom is active.
This will prevent you from scrolling through your hotbar while zooming if enabled.
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.smoothness.de:
FOV changes will be spread out over this many milliseconds.
Set to `0` to disable animations.
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.easing.title: Easing Exponent
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.easing.desc:
Smoothing animation progress will be raised to this exponent for easing. Higher numbers will feel faster.
It is recommended to also increase `zoomSmoothnessMs` when increasing this.
Set to `1` to disable.
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.quadratics.de:
Zoom percentage will be squared before being applied if `true`.
Makes differences in FOV more uniform. You should probably keep this on if you don't understand what it does.
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.default.title: Default Zoom
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.toggle.title: Toggle Mode
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.toggle.desc: If `true`, the Zoom keybind will act as a toggle. If `false`, Zoom will only be active while the keybind is held.
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.max.title: Maximum FOV
english.sodium.extras.options.zoom.min.title: Minimum FOV
Configures how Borderless Fullscreen should be attached

ATTACH - Adds it between windowed and Fullscreen
REPLACE - Replaced Fullscreen with Borderless Fullscreen
OFF - Disables Borderless Fullscreen attachment to F11 key
english.sodium.extras.options.others.languagescr: If enabled, Language updates only reload language instead of all resources, a 99.9% extra of speed

original.sodium.extras.options.culling.entity.tit: 使用实体最大渲染距离
original.sodium.extras.options.culling.entity.des: 启用后，游戏将会基于所配置的最大距离进行实体的隐藏。
original.sodium.extras.options.culling.entity.dis: 实体最大渲染距离（水平）
隐藏并停止更新超过此范围的实体。大幅提高性能，尤其是在模组刷怪塔周围时。
实体最大渲染距离（垂直）
隐藏并停止更新此范围下方的实体，提高位于洞穴上方时的性能。理想情况下，该值应低于水平距离。
original.sodium.extras.options.culling.tiles.titl: 使用方块实体最大渲染距离
original.sodium.extras.options.culling.tiles.desc: 启用后，游戏将会基于所配置的最大距离进行方块实体的隐藏。
original.sodium.extras.options.culling.tile.dista: 方块实体最大渲染距离（水平）
隐藏超过此范围的方块实体。大幅提高性能，尤其是在大量模组机器周围时。
方块实体最大渲染距离（垂直）
隐藏此范围下方的方块实体，提高位于洞穴（哦，出于某种原因，你把机器放在洞穴里了）上方时的性能。理想情况下，该值应低于水平距离。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.mode.desc:
真实黑暗功能会使世界其他地方的黑暗更为逼真。这不会影响白天或火把的光照。
此项可以开关真实黑暗，以及控制什么样的黑暗被视为真正的黑暗。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.others.de:
启用后，真实黑暗会在其他维度生效。

[警告] 此项将在不久之后被移除，由黑名单取而代之。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.overworld: 启用后，真实黑暗会在主世界生效。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.noskyligh: 启用后，真实黑暗会在没有天空的维度生效。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.nether.de: 启用后，真实黑暗会在下界生效。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.nether.br: 启用下界的真实黑暗后，可在此配置下界的迷雾亮度。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.end.title: 末地
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.end.desc: 启用后，真实黑暗会在末地生效。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.end.brigh: 启用末地的真实黑暗后，可在此配置末地的迷雾亮度。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.blockligh: 启用后，会禁用天空、迷雾和月亮的亮度，使方块成为唯一的光源。
original.sodium.extras.options.darkness.moonphase: 启用后，真实黑暗会受月相影响。
配置新月的亮度，或者黑月的最小亮度等级。
配置满月的亮度，或者黑月的最大亮度等级。
original.sodium.extras.options.displayfps.title: 显示FPS
original.sodium.extras.options.displayfps.desc: 显示当前FPS。高级模式还显示最低FPS、前15秒内的平均FPS，这对评估性能很有用。
在FPS计数器旁边，显示内存和GPU的占用量。
FPS信息的偏移距离，单位为像素。
给FPS信息加上阴影框背景，阴影是纯粹的F3风格。
original.sodium.extras.options.dynlights.tiles.de:
启用后，将为方块实体（熔炉、模组机器等）启用动态光源。

即使你没有拿着火把，光照更新的数量也会由于此项而急剧增加。
original.sodium.extras.options.dynlights.entities:
启用后，将为实体（生物、掉落的物品等）启用动态光源。

即使你没有拿着火把，光照更新的数量也会由于此项而急剧增加。
original.sodium.extras.options.dynlights.speed.de:
控制动态光源的更新频率。

重新计算光照会很吃性能，因此频率越低（速度越慢）性能就越好。
original.sodium.extras.options.fadein.title: 区块淡入品质
original.sodium.extras.options.fadein.desc: 控制区块淡入的速度。不吃性能，高品质也只是需要更长的时间，然而很炫酷。目前不生效。
original.sodium.extras.options.fastchest.title: 启用快速箱子
original.sodium.extras.options.fastchest.desc:
启用后，用静态模型替换箱子原有的模型，就类似普通方块。会破坏箱子动画，但箱子较多的地方变流畅了。

对安装了飞轮，且运行批处理或实例化后端的情况，该选项没有效果。
original.sodium.extras.options.fastbeds.title: 启用快速的床
original.sodium.extras.options.fastbeds.desc: 启用后，用静态模型替换床原有的动态模型，就类似普通方块。增强了性能的同时，你仍然可以使用资源包中的自定义模型。
original.sodium.extras.options.fog.title: 启用迷雾
original.sodium.extras.options.fog.desc: 禁用后，移除世界中的所有迷雾效果。
original.sodium.extras.options.fontshadow.title: 字体阴影
original.sodium.extras.options.fontshadow.desc:
禁用后，文本将停止渲染阴影，显得扁平化。
FPS能提高多少，取决于屏幕上有多少文本，特别是安装了更好的F3（BetterF3）模组后。
original.sodium.extras.options.jei.title: 不在搜索时隐藏JEI
original.sodium.extras.options.jei.desc: 启用后，会隐藏JEI物品列表中的物品，直到你搜索了某些内容。输入空格可以搜索到所有内容。
original.sodium.extras.options.screen.title: 全屏模式
original.sodium.extras.options.screen.desc:
窗口化 - 游戏将在一个小窗口中显示。
无边框 - 游戏将全屏显示、将帧率锁定到你显示器的刷新率，但允许你随便切换到其他窗口。
全屏 - 游戏将以原生全屏模式显示。
启用后，可以使用F11切换到无边框状态。

改变设置后，需要重启游戏以生效。
original.sodium.extras.options.others.languagescr: 启用后，改变语言只会重载语言，不再重载所有资源，速度提高99.9%。

added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.cinematic.des:
缩放时启用电影视角。
关闭后，也可以尝试将 `zoomSmoothnessMs` 设为 `0`。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.sensitive.des:
缩放时，鼠标灵敏度不会降到此值以下。
设为 `1.0` 可保持灵敏度不变；未启用 `enableCinematicZoom` 时不建议这样设置。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.speed.title: 缩放速度
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.speed.desc: 设置放大、缩小快捷键及滚轮缩放（启用时）的速度。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.scrolling.des:
缩放期间，允许使用鼠标滚轮放大或缩小。
启用后，缩放期间滚轮不会切换快捷栏物品。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.smoothness.de:
将视野变化平滑分布在指定毫秒内。
设为 `0` 可关闭动画。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.easing.title: 缓动指数
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.easing.desc:
用此指数调整平滑动画进度。数值越高，感觉越快。
提高此值时，也建议增大 `zoomSmoothnessMs`。
设为 `1` 可关闭缓动。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.quadratics.de:
启用后，先将缩放百分比平方，再应用缩放。
可使视野变化更均匀；不确定其作用时，建议保持启用。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.default.title: 默认缩放
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.default.desc: 设置开始缩放时的默认百分比。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.toggle.title: 切换模式
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.toggle.desc: 启用后，按一次缩放键开启，再按一次关闭；关闭后，仅按住缩放键时生效。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.max.title: 最大视野角
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.max.desc: 设置缩放时的最大视野角。
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.min.title: 最小视野角
added.sodium.extras.options.zoom.min.desc: 设置缩放时的最小视野角。

english.iris.shaders.debug.enabled: Debugging has been enabled, debug logging will be more verbose!
english.iris.shaders.debug.failure: Cannot enable client debugging, your computer does not support debug features. Shader debugging has been enabled.
english.iris.shaders.debug.restart: You do not have a debug context, please restart to enable OpenGL client debugging.
english.iris.shaders.debug.restartNoDebug: Shader debugging has been enabled; OpenGL debugging is unsupported on NeoForge.
english.iris.load.failure.shader: The shaderpack failed to load! Please report the error to the shader developer.
english.iris.load.failure.generic: Iris encountered an issue trying to load the shader; please report this to Iris developers.
english.iris.shaders.ssbofailure: The shader requested a specific feature (SSBO) that is not supported by your GPU, it may not work correctly.
english.iris.sodium.failure.title: Iris failed to load!
english.iris.sodium.failure.reason.notFound: Iris requires Sodium for good performance, but Sodium is not installed. Please download Sodium, place it in your mods folder, and re-launch the game.
english.iris.sodium.failure.reason.incompatible: Iris requires Sodium for good performance, but an incompatible version was found. Please download the correct version of Sodium, place it in your mods folder, remove the incorrect version, and re-launch the game.
english.iris.nec.failure.title: [%s] Not Enough Crashes detected!
english.iris.nec.failure.description:
Not Enough Crashes can severely break the game while handling crashes, and does not provide accurate results.
A good alternative is MixinTrace, which can identify the cause of a crash more reliably and does not put the game in an invalid state.
